title: TCP Slow Start, Congestion Avoidance, Fast Retransmit, and Fast Recovery Algorithms
summary: Writes down four tangled congestion control algorithms in TCP: slow start, congestion avoidance, fast retransmit, and fast recovery. Implementations already used them but they had never been documented as standards. It was replaced by RFC 2581.

eli5.summary: Start by sending a little, then more and more until the road gets crowded, then slow down. TCP carefully feels out how fast the road lets it go.

questions: how does tcp congestion avoidance work
